module: Traffic light editor ("Traffic Signals Editor" window, menu Window > Gameplay, signalsEditMode edit mode). Lets you create and place signals (instances), controllers and phase sequences, edit controller definitions, simulate the lights in the level then save everything to the level's signals.json (editor.levelPath). Works on core_trafficSignals data (newSignal, newController, newSequence, setupSignals, loadSignals). Shift + left click creates a signal, left click selects.
usage:
local data = editor_trafficSignalsEditor.getCurrentSignals() -- {instances, controllers, sequences}
editor_trafficSignalsEditor.saveFile() -- writes <level>/signals.json
notes: loadFile and saveFile default to editor.levelPath..'signals.json'; the File menu only handles this default file.
loadFile: if the data contains the obsolete key 'intersections', it is rejected (warning "Obsolete signals data!") and the editor is emptied via setCurrentSignals({}).

The simulation (local function simulate) forces the sequences into test mode, calls map.reset() to update the mapmgr signals ("temporary" solution according to the code) and sets trafficSignals.debugLevel back to 0 on stop, reloading the level's original signals.

getCurrentElements.desc: Returns the table of editor elements (signals, controllers, sequences) keyed by id.

getCurrentSignals.desc: Returns the signal data being edited (live tables, not copied).

setCurrentSignals.desc: Replaces the editor data: resets, recreates instances (pos/dir converted to vec3), controllers and sequences via core_trafficSignals, then reselects the current elements. Without an argument, uses the level's signals (core_trafficSignals.getData()).

data.desc: {instances, controllers, sequences}; missing fields treated as empty.

loadFile.desc: Loads a JSON signals file and applies it with setCurrentSignals (obsolete format rejected).

saveFile.desc: Writes the serialized signals to a JSON file (jsonWriteFile) and displays "Signals saved!" for 3 s.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor frame hook: draws the window (File menu Load/Save/Clear, lists and properties of signals, controllers, sequences) and the signals' debug rendering. Initializes the tables on the first call.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor initialization hook: registers the window (540x600), the signalsEditMode edit mode with its shortcuts and the menu entry in the Gameplay group.

onWindowMenuItem.desc: Menu hook: initializes the tables if needed, clears the object selection and shows the window.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook: forces a re-initialization of the tables on the next opening.

onSerialize.desc: Before Lua reload: returns {options, signals} (serialized signals).

onDeserialized.desc: After Lua reload: restores the options and reapplies the signals with setCurrentSignals.
